changelog: Spoken punctuation now understands quotes and dashes: say "open quote" / "close quote" (or "উদ্ধৃতি শুরু" / "উদ্ধৃতি শেষ" in Bengali) and curly quotes appear around your words — handy for quoted speech in a dictated story. Say "dash" for a spaced em dash (—) and "hyphen" to glue words together ("well hyphen known" becomes "well-known"). Works in the app and in the voice keyboard, only when the spoken-punctuation setting is on.
